body: {"title":"A week in Lisbon","body":"We arrived on Monday -- tired but happy. The hotel (a converted convent) was quiet; breakfast was served from 7 to 10. On Tuesday we took tram 28 to the old town, then walked down to the river. Prices: coffee 1.20, pastel de nata 1.50, dinner 25-30 per person. Highly recommended! Don't miss the sunset at the viewpoint (Miradouro da Senhora do Monte). Rating: 5/5 -- would go again."}
